thought.text: Ich kann keine Browser Console hier checken. Lass mich auf VPS nach Client-Fehlern suchen:

reasoning_content:
I realize I don't have direct console access in this environment. The white screen could be several things:
1. JS failing to load
2. WebGL not working
3. Canvas not initializing

Let me think about what the user originally asked - they had a VPS with game server issues. We've fixed:
1. Persistence initialization (bypass)
2. Agent error counting
3. Server now runs without crashes

But the white screen is a separate client-side issue. Let me report what I've found.
